name: walk_backward
text: A person walks backward continuously in a straight line while still facing forward. Alternating cautious backward steps, place each foot behind the body and shift weight back, arms relaxed slightly outward for balance. Remain facing the same direction throughout, never turn around. Steady backward walking.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 始终面向前方、交替向后迈步；根位移朝后，双臂在身旁轻摆保持平衡。两个步态组成循环，没有转身后正走。
